newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prisoners flee after negotiating cars, arms.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prisoners flee after negotiating cars, arms.

text.p: Armed prisoners were holding three hostages in Brazil on Wednesday after driving out of a prison in the northern city of Fortaleza, local television reported.

The incident began on Tuesday when about 25 prisoners seized 17 hostages in the prison, Globo Television said. One hostage jumped from a window soon afterward and a 30-year-old lawyer who was eight months pregnant was released.
The prisoners later released 10 of the remaining 15 hostages in return for cars and weapons to drive them from prison.
Globo said about 12 prisoners decided to make the escape attempt, in which one was shot and killed. The prisoners later released two more hostages.
The vehicles were covered with newspaper to prevent police from knowing exactly how many of the prisoners were in each car. Globo said they were armed with 20 revolvers and ammunition.
Military police and prison officials in Fortaleza could not be reached to confirm the report.
